title: Phase 3 retest and phase 4
eyebrow: Branch AjsAgent/speed-switches updated from main; phase 3 retested on aj's Windows PC

short.lead: The branch now contains everything on main (92 commits; one changelog conflict, kept both sides, nothing pushed). On this Windows PC the hook check script (verify.py) passes 1246 of 1252 checks and the tools check (tools/verify_tools.py) passes 53 of 54. All 7 failures are tests that assume Linux paths (the /tmp folder, forward slashes, node -e); none is a phase 3 feature failing, and CI on main passes the same code on Linux. The live headless-session tests were not re-run here, because each starts paid sessions. Phase 4 was not started: all 15 of its issues are already closed.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was run and what it showed.
items: git merge of origin/main: 92 commits in, 0 left behind. The only conflict was CHANGELOG.md, resolved by keeping both entries. Nothing pushed.

The failing six are in safe_git (guard cwd check, audit entries, rm -rf under /tmp), design_loop (page-check cases using docs/plans paths) and make_page (the node -e check). All are Windows path assumptions in the tests.
The one failure is A16 (force_update when the reinstall fails). It ran against this PC's real plugin setup, where the marketplace name was not found.
The roadmap's finish test is still open: a recorded day of real commands with no refusal of a recoverable action, and no helper waiting on a prompt nobody can answer.
Choose: run the recorded-day check, or fix the Windows-only tests first (my suggestion: the recorded-day check).
